# EPV findings this extension keeps on purpose, checked by the epv job in
# .github/workflows/tests.yml. One finding per line as EPV prints it, without
# "on line N", with paths relative to the extension; give the reason above it.

# Heading anchors, the table of contents and wiki-link fragments are escaped
# with ENT_QUOTES on purpose; utf8_htmlspecialchars() would only use ENT_COMPAT.
Error: Using htmlspecialchars in /event/wikilink_listener.php
Error: Using htmlspecialchars in /wiki/markup.php
Error: Using htmlspecialchars in /wiki/templates.php

# Discussion text is re-encoded for XML with ENT_NOQUOTES | ENT_XML1, which
# utf8_htmlspecialchars() can't do.
Error: Using htmlspecialchars in /wiki/discussion.php

# The search index progress-bar URL is escaped for a JavaScript string, as in
# phpBB's own acp_search.php.
Error: Using addslashes in /controller/acp_search.php

# ext.php reads phpBB's own serialized migration dependency lists and the
# reparser resume point when it moves an install made under the old vendor
# name, with allowed_classes off, so no objects can be created.
Error: Using unserialize in /ext.php

# Released migrations that add columns to the wiki_article table, which
# initial_module's revert_schema() drops when the extension's data is deleted,
# so there is nothing for these migrations to revert. Released migrations must
# not be changed.
Error: Migration file /migrations/update_0_2_0.php is missing the revert_schema() method.
Error: Migration file /migrations/update_0_3_0.php is missing the revert_schema() method.
Error: Migration file /migrations/update_0_3_1.php is missing the revert_schema() method.
Error: Migration file /migrations/update_0_3_2.php is missing the revert_schema() method.
